append output io/ascii rejoin [iterations "^- trees of depth " depth "^- check: " total "^/"]
append output io/ascii rejoin ["long lived tree of depth " maximum-depth "^- check: " (check-tree long-lived) "^/"]
cumulative: func [probabilities [block!] /local result total code probability]

random-sequence: func [output [binary!] count [integer!] distribution [block!] seed [integer!]
    /local draw position code column]
while [all [position < length? distribution draw >= (pick distribution position)]]
append output io/ascii ">ONE Homo sapiens alu^/"

seed: random-sequence output (5 * n) (cumulative homo) seed
decode-word: func [key [integer!] width [integer!] /local result position digit]
read-three: func [input [binary!] /local sequence selected line header token token-end byte]
while [all [token-end <= length? header not find [9 32] (pick header token-end)]]

frequency: func [output [binary!] table [map!] width [integer!] denominator [integer!]
    /local entries key count entry]
append output io/ascii rejoin [entry/1 " " (io/fixed ((100.0 * entry/2) / denominator) 3) "^/"]
count: select (pick tables map-index) (encode-word io/ascii query)
append output io/ascii rejoin [either none? count [0] [count] "^-" query "^/"]
append output io/ascii rejoin ["P4^/" n " " n "^/"]
planet: func [x y z vx vy vz mass]
reduce [x y z (vx * days-per-year) (vy * days-per-year) (vz * days-per-year) (mass * solar-mass)]
energy: func [bodies [block!] /local total i j left right dx dy dz squared speed2]
advance: func [bodies [block!] /local i j left right dx dy dz squared magnitude axis displacement slot]
poke left slot ((pick left slot) - ((displacement * right/7) * magnitude))
poke right slot ((pick right slot) + ((displacement * left/7) * magnitude))
poke left axis ((pick left axis) + (0.01 * (pick left (axis + 3))))
poke momentum axis ((pick momentum axis) + ((pick body (axis + 3)) * body/7))
poke sun (axis + 3) ((negate pick momentum axis) / solar-mass)
count-matches: func [pattern [binary!] subject [binary!] /local position hit count]
while [not none? hit: rx/find pattern subject position]
io/fail "Unexpected empty match in selected counting pattern"

replace-all: func [pattern [binary!] replacement [binary!] subject [binary!]
    /local result position hit]
while [not none? hit: rx/find pattern subject position]
io/fail "Unexpected empty match in selected substitution pattern"
append output io/ascii rejoin [pattern " " (count-matches (io/ascii pattern) sequence) "^/"]
append output io/ascii rejoin ["^/" (length? input) "^/" (length? sequence) "^/" (length? replaced) "^/"]
emit-record: func [output [binary!] header [binary!] sequence [binary!] /local position column byte found]
product: func [input [block!] transposed [logic!] /local result n i j sum factor]
factor: either transposed [coefficient j i] [coefficient i j]
uv: uv + ((pick u index) * (pick v index))
vv: vv + ((pick v index) * (pick v index))

decisions.fannkuch-zero: Count the additive zero-size main instead of the archived rejecting main. Its row7 either is one composed binding; all positive-size permutation/flip statements remain unchanged. Loader row2 selects the exact retained IO facade.
decisions.metadata: Rebol header/spec/type/local/argument blocks are structural data; preserve authored data wrapping.
decisions.functions: Every exact func body here has explicit brackets: header1/open0/body owners/close1, even one-expression bodies.
decisions.context: The three exact context constructors have evaluated definition bodies: header1/open0/body owners/close1.
decisions.conditions: while condition blocks, including chunk/hit bindings, remain part of the single loop header; body block is separate.
decisions.either: Only listed scalar-result compositions are single values. Multi-statement arms retain body owners and both written closes; no unwritten else header is invented.
decisions.case: revcomp case and each written condition arm have explicit headers; the empty comment arm retains its written close.
decisions.callback: knucleotide row61 combines sort/compare containing prefix with the first func header; one value body and one close follow.
decisions.switch-value: knucleotide base-code has four single-constant arms; retained n-control.c REBNATIVE(switch) returns selected block result or R_NONE on no match.
decisions.c-module: C rows22-35 retain declaration and every authored string/data row; rows27-35 expose all nine command declarations. No second count of runtime-produced module text.
decisions.c-enum: Rows37-38 contain header1/open0, nine independent enum constants, written close1.
decisions.c-bindings: Comma declarations and the RXA_TYPE chain have explicit separate owners; macro invocations are counted as authored, without expansion.
decisions.data: FASTA probability wrapping, nbody argument/data wrapping and regex pattern/replacement rows remain physical data units, including written data delimiters.
